articleTitle: Image Target Detection Algorithm Based on Computer Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the rapid development of intelligent systems and the advent of the era of big data, the continuous development of computers is being promoted. Exporting and tracking moving targets in video images is one of the most important research contents of computer vision. It combines many advanced technologies in the field of computing, such as image processing, pattern recognition, automatic control and artificial intelligence, and is widely used in intelligent surveillance. In various fields such as traffic control, machine intelligence and medical diagnosis, visual effects are obtained through image or image processing. Record videos from the computer and perform specific mechanical tasks. In terms of intelligent tracking, as the demand for applications in various complex environments continues to grow, how to improve the robustness and accuracy of moving target tracking and tracking algorithms has become the focus of ongoing target tracking research. This paper studies the image target detection algorithm based on computer vision technology. Firstly, the literature research method is used to summarize the existing problems of image target detection based on computer vision technology and the existing algorithms. The experiment is used to analyze the image target based on computer vision technology. The detection algorithm is verified, and the error rate of image target detection of the algorithm proposed in this paper is compared. According to the experimental results, it can be seen from Figure 1 that in experiment 1, the target detection of the GMM-STMRF algorithm is more accurate than other methods based on the calculation of the false detection rate. The maximum false detection rate is only 2.3%, and the other algorithms have 5.4%- 11.1% false detection rate The GMM-STMRF algorithm increases the multi-frame calculation in the time dimension, so the calculation time has increased. Algorithms such as GMM and MeanShift need to estimate the multi-frame parameters, and the time complexity is also high. In experiment 2, the target detection of the GMM-STMRF algorithm is more accurate than other methods based on the calculation of the false detection rate. The highest false detection rate is only 2.2%, and the other algorithms have a false detection rate of 6.1%-11.8%, respectively. Among them, Meanshift is the highest, Gaussian mixture model is behind, and FCM takes the second place. According to Table I, Table II, Table III, the false detection rate of picture recognition in the video library is quite different from the false detection rate of pictures taken in reality. This is related to the complexity of the picture frequency shooting background environment.

articleTitle: A Study on the Collision of Artificial Intelligence and Art Based on Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN)
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The cross-collision of artificial intelligence and art has attracted significant attention in related fields, such as the migration and integration of painting styles. Due to the inherent differences of different painting techniques, direct application of existing methods does not bring satisfactory results. This paper proposes a multi-layer Pyramid Generative Adversarial Network (MPGAN), an end-to-end Generative Adversarial Network(GAN) based architecture, whose advantages are in image quality and better-scaled fusion of painting styles compared with state-of-the-art algorithms demonstrate the effectiveness of the method. The method's effectiveness is demonstrated by its advantages in image quality compared to the state-of-the-art algorithms and its better scaling fusion of painting styles.

articleTitle: Research into Digital Oil Painting Restoration Algorithm Based on Image Acquisition Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In this study, the damaged oil painting is digitally collected by image acquisition technology, and the micro repair is realized by deconstructing the oil painting image. The integration of digital technology can more scientifically reveal the oil painting techniques and oil painting materials used, so as to provide a more scientific technical basis for the aging and damage repair of oil paintings and even oil painting cultural relics. Under this technical background, this research is based on the image acquisition technology to repair the damaged oil painting area, and uses the digital repair technology to collect the image of the specific damaged area of the oil painting. Then, the original pixels of the damaged area are identified by digital algorithm, and finally the pixel extension is obtained to realize the image repair of the damaged area. This repair is more accurate and has no coloring coverage, so it has wider applicability and better effect than the traditional repair.

articleTitle: Research of Visual SLAM in Dynamic Environment using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) can be implemented by using computer vision method. Current visual SLAM is mainly applied in static environments, and dynamic environments can cause mis-matching of feature points in the process of pose estimation due to the movement of objects, resulting in poor localization accuracy. In this paper, we propose Mask R-CNN method using convolutional neural network to optimize the tracking of visual front-end, effectively fuse ORB SLAM with Mask R-CNN algorithm. And polar line geometry method is also adopted to reject dynamic feature points. The research work solves the problem that the mis-matching of dynamic feature distribution points in the feature distribution point matching process, which causes poorer localization accuracy. Finally, a comparison test is performed with the ORB SLAM2 algorithm using a public dataset. The result illustrates that the improved algorithm enhance the localization accuracy of the optimized SLAM in a dynamic environment using the fusion of Mask R-CNN and ORB SLAM without affecting the system real-time performance.

Author Keywords: the Oriented fast and Brief SLAM

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Energy Virtual Power Plant Based on Spatial Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: To analyze the development potential of distributed energy access to VPP, First, the spatial prediction model of wind and photovoltaic power generation is constructed. Further, the development potential model of distributed energy access to virtual power plant is constructed from three aspects of power saving potential, pollutant emission reduction potential and economic potential. Finally, taking a VPP as an example, the effectiveness, stability and applicability of the model are analyzed, Example results: distributed energy output has obvious seasonal characteristics, and distributed energy access to virtual power plants has good potential in environmental protection, economy and security.

articleTitle: Class D Power Amplifier Based on Waveform Predistortion Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless communication technology, out of the pursuit of higher spectrum efficiency and higher power efficiency, the linearization technology of class D power amplifiers has become an important research direction. The purpose of this article is to study the design and implementation of Class D power amplifiers based on waveform predistortion technology. It introduces in detail the causes and theoretical analysis of several non-linear distortions in the class D audio amplifier, and proposes corresponding solutions, and introduces the modulation methods of several popular class D audio amplifiers, as well as each method. At the same time, several main performance indicators and design points of Class D audio amplifiers are explained. The nonlinear distortion in the open-loop and closed-loop class-D audio amplifiers was modeled and analyzed separately, and some parameters that had a greater impact on the system performance were extracted. Although the frequency of the oscillator is less than 500kHz, it is still very close to the design index, which is low for the design. The distortion class D audio amplifier has great reference value.

articleTitle: Research into Oil Painting Recognition and Analysis System Based on Image Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In the information society, the art market is quickly expanding in volume, and the development of oil painting art, as an important component of the art industry, is increasingly going global and becoming popularized. In order to improve the analysis and recognition ability of oil paintings with increasingly large volume, this study designs an oil painting recognition and analysis system based on image intelligent algorithm, which integrates the recognition of oil painting color and literary and scientific features and the intelligent detection function of oil painting. Through intelligent recognition of oil painting features, this study calculate the difference threshold between oil painting color and shape features, so as to realize the accurate recognition of oil painting.

articleTitle: Improving the Bag-of-words Model Using the Hubness Phenomenon for Skeleton-based Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: This paper proposes a new bag-of-words (BoW) approach for human skeletal action recognition based on the hubness phenomenon. Many previous action recognition methods adopt a BoW method that ignores the high dimensions of the feature space. Hence, this paper presents a visual vocabulary construction approach for action recognition. The action feature descriptors including the spatial-temporal joint information are first extracted from action sequences. Various factors are considered in the spatial descriptors, including the three-dimensional coordinates of the joints, angles between body segments, and direction, as well as elevation angles. The feature vectors with higher hubness scores are then selected as candidates. Finally, the visual words are selected from the candidates using the maximin method. We evaluated the effectiveness of the proposed method on two public datasets, the CAD-60 and UTKinect datasets. The experimental results show that the proposed method performs better than several state-of-the-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Online on-Demand Platform of Piano Repertoire Based on Streaming Media Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Video-on-demand is a new way to disseminate multimedia information, transmitting the video content clicked or selected by the user to the requested user, providing the user with real-time, high-quality on-demand services. Streaming is to split the video data to be transmitted into several small data blocks, and the mobile terminal adopts the way of playing while downloading, which has the advantages of low latency and high flexibility compared with complete downloading and playing. We developed an online on-demand platform for piano repertoire to make up for the shortcomings of online teaching of piano courses. The platform uses the new standard of video coding based on streaming technology, the data storage structure design based on MySQL, and the online on-demand video playing interaction process based on flowchart design to provide a complete solution for the system development.

articleTitle: The Fuzzy Control Method Based on Dynamic Self-optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the control environment of the ball mill and the coal quality, humidity, hardness, steel ball filling factor, armor wear degree, etc. have a great influence on the operation characteristics of the mill, and the precise mathematical model cannot be determined, this paper proposes a method that does not depend on The dynamic self-optimizing control method of the mathematical model of the control object, especially when designing the control loop based on the load of the ball mill, is easy to determine the control target value and has a good effect. The simulation results prove the real--time nature of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Management Platform of Sports Service Industry Based on WebGIS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: WebGIS is the geographic information system software of GIS system running on the Web side. It is the extension and development of GIS on the Internet. It uses two parts, the server and the client, to realize the transmission and expression of GIS information. WebGIS technology is applied to the sports service industry, and the unique spatial analysis and query function of WebGIS is used to organically combine WebGIS technology with the sports service industry. Build a comprehensive management platform for sports service industry based on WebGIS, make full use of new technologies such as HTML5, Java Script and CGI; and A* algorithm for optimal path planning, which is faster and saves space than the traversal path planning algorithm; the comprehensive management platform of the sports service industry is designed into several subsystems to provide services for the relevant departments of the sports service industry.

articleTitle: Research on Non-contact Surface Deformation Monitoring System Based on UWB Positioning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: This paper introduces the principle and characteristics of UWB positioning measurement. On the basis of Single side two-way ranging mode, double-sided two-way ranging mode method is proposed and applied to the actual positioning measurement system. The static test platform of the positioning system is built, and the static positioning of a tag is calculated by using the scheme of 4 base stations and 1 console. The standard deviation is used as the evaluation index of positioning effect, and good positioning and ranging results are obtained.

articleTitle: An Improved Threshold Image Separation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In the light of noise sensitivity and low robustness in the traditional threshold photo cutting algorithm, an improved photo cutting algorithm based on genetic algorithm is proposed. In this method, the gray value evaluation criteria are made for different regions of the image, and the photo cutting problem is defined as a multi-region independent optimization problem. Using the optimization efficiency of genetic algorithm, the image segmentation threshold that can make the segmentation quality reach the optimal is searched. The results of simulation proved to be effective for the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Improved Human-Object Interaction Based Lightweight Openpose
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In order to improve the performance as well as the requirement of lightweight, the human-object interaction detection network of GGNet including the improved Lightweight Openpose is proposed. The Lightweight Openpose algorithm is introduced to substitute for the feature extraction module in the GGNet network as the feature extraction network. The improved GGNet network has an accuracy of 96.6% and a recall of 82.6%, which is a significant improvement in speed and accuracy compared to using the original GGNet feature extraction network.

articleTitle: Adaptive Assessment Method of High Voltage Power Metering Operation Process Based on Information Fusion in VR Training
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In the relevant operation of power grid under high voltage circumstance, the adaptability evaluation of specific operation process, the priority guarantee strategy of important safety tasks, and the consistency and reliability evaluation of overall execution operation are the important basis for the establishment of safe operation rules. In this paper, a DS evidence theory based multi-level component evaluation index safety procedure operation evaluation standard is proposed. An example is given to analyze the electroscope operation in the operation behavior of power operation. The AHP and D-S evidence theory are applied to the adaptability evaluation of the operation flow of high-voltage power measurement. Based on the electroscope operation process, a tree structure of adaptability evaluation index for relevant operations was constructed. According to the comparison judgment of indicators in relevant operations, the judgment matrix between corresponding levels is constructed respectively, and the weight between corresponding levels is obtained through the matrix eigenvector. The d-S evidence theory is used to fuse the prior data to obtain the final fitness. The result is helpful to design a more reasonable operation process of safety regulations.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Method Based on Adaptive Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: The rapid development of computer software and hardware technology has laid a very solid foundation for computer vision tasks such as target recognition that use images as input carriers. The purpose of this paper is to study face recognition methods based on adaptive feature fusion. The principle of Adaboost algorithm and the training process of strong classifier and the cascade process of strong classifier of Adaboost algorithm are studied. The algorithm of face detection is improved through Haar-like feature extraction and weight update during algorithm iteration. At the same time, in order to detect the face more accurately and quickly, the method of skin color detection is introduced to extract the candidate face region, and an initialization model that can adapt to the change of the target face is proposed based on the previous invariant average initialization model. Then, the Adaboost algorithm is experimentally tested through the face database, network pictures, and video images combined with the previous image preprocessing method. The detection rate of the face database can reach 97.56%. The test results show that the algorithm can meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Research into Digital Sculpture Technology Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the accelerated update and renewal of China's information technology, the digital social system tends to take shape, which also indirectly promotes the digital transformation and development of traditional industries. As one of the industries that can be transformed by modern information technology, the development of sculpture industry is related to the direction of the future sculpture product market. The production and display of sculpture works can be divided into traditional and digital display. Traditional sculpture technology is based on artificial technology, through the artificial design and modeling of works, supplemented by detailed work setting drawings as a reference, it cannot realize the free and convenient creation of work models. However, digital sculpture technology can replace manual modeling, help sculptors create digital models through computers, and realize the sculpture process of machine instead of manual. Therefore, in view of the disadvantages of traditional sculpture, this study is based on AI digital sculpture technology, and combines sculpture technology with computers and sculpture machines through the blessing of digital technology to realize more intuitive, convenient and efficient digital sculpture.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Coronary Artery Segmentation Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: At present, the health of the elderly has been the general concern of the whole society. Cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death among the elderly. The diagnosis of cardiovascular diseases often relies on the experience of cardiologists to find the location of coronary vascular lesions from medical images. Due to the dense blood vessels around the heart and complex tissues, the identification of coronary arteries often leads to misjudgment, which leads to inaccurate diagnosis of the disease. The application of computer technology to the automatic identification and segmentation of coronary arteries can greatly improve the accuracy of diagnosis, so as to realize the effective control of cardiovascular disease mortality. This project designed a coronary vessel segmentation algorithm based on deep learning, and built U-net and VGG16 network under PyTorch environment, which could identify most vessels in coronary vessel images. Using cross test method, 100 groups of coronary artery data sets were tested, and good segmentation results were obtained, which provided convenience for cardiologists in the diagnosis of coronary heart disease.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Video Image Target Detection (TD) and Tracking Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning technology and some related neural network models have shown strong learning ability in hierarchical feature learning, and have made great achievements in image classification, target recognition and scene understanding. Considering the strong hierarchical feature learning ability of deep network model, a correlation filter detection and tracking model based on dynamic spatial feature selection is proposed in this paper; In order to further improve the mathematical modeling method of the algorithm and improve the accuracy of the algorithm, a correlation filter detection and tracking model based on the fusion of spatial feature selection and channel feature selection is proposed; In order to optimize the mathematical modeling method of the algorithm and improve the real-time performance of the algorithm, an accelerated correlation filter detection and tracking model based on improved alternating direction multiplier method is proposed. The experimental results show that the depth feature of the algorithm proposed in this paper has excellent tracking accuracy and robustness, can be well applied to real-time tracking scenes, realizes model dimensionality reduction and improves the detection and tracking performance; In otb100 dataset, this algorithm achieves the optimal position prediction success rate under the 20 pixel error threshold and the tracking success rate under the 50% overlap threshold. The success rate curve srdcf is slightly higher than that of AUC algorithm; In templecolor128 dataset, although the algorithm proposed in this chapter only obtains the second overlapping accuracy and the third position accuracy, its tracking accuracy is very close to that of stable and srdcf algorithms; In terms of the real-time performance of the algorithm, the algorithm proposed in this paper can well meet the needs of real-time tracking.

articleTitle: On the Use of LSTM-RNN for Detecting Audio Spoofing Attacks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: This paper proposes a long short-term memory recurrent neural network (LSTM-RNN) for detecting audio spoofing attacks. Many algorithms, including deep learning technology, have made a lot of achievements in this field. However, the automatic speaker verification (ASV) system is still vulnerable to a spoofing attack. Therefore, in this paper, we analyze the architecture of LSTM-RNN and apply the LSTM-RNN method. Considering the application of LSTM-RNN in speech recognition, we believe that LSTM-RNN can also play a prominent role in this application. To verify our proposed approach, we take the ASVspoof 2015 dataset for the test. We use two kinds of features in the experiment: Mel-scale Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) and Log-FBank. Among them, the Log-FBank feature system can achieve better performance. The experimental results show that the ASV system can be used in practice with the LSTM method.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Current Situation Network Survey System for Female Science and Technology Workers Based on J2EE
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: J2EE is an industry development standard based on Java language. On the basis of maintaining the independence of Java language platform, it solves the system interface compatibility between programs, reduces the coupling degree between modules, and makes the software development process more clear and concise. In J2EE layered architecture, Web browser and Applet access the presentation layer, application client access the business logic layer, J2EE application server and enterprise information system layer access based on the unified interface. This paper designs the network survey content, which consists of 8 categories, and each category includes 3 specific questions. Questionnaire survey program is designed. Users can choose to answer questions with their real names or anonymously. The research results of this paper, provide the complete solution for the development of the network investigation system of the current situation of female scientific and technological workers.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Image Relief Based on Computer 3D Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer graphics and image technology and 3D modeling, great progress has been made in the field of 3D digital relief. Hollowed out relief is a form of concave relief, which is obtained by carving out the background plane on the basis of concave relief. Digital relief is generated by computer-aided modeling, which overcomes the shortcomings of traditional manual relief, such as low production efficiency and difficult to modify products, and is easy to save. In this paper, the design and implementation of image relief based on computer 3D modeling, the basic modeling process of computer 3D modeling, plane relief and the generation method of fractal pattern concave relief based on distance transformation are discussed. A differential algorithm is proposed to realize the concave convex effect of image relief. Experiments are carried out on different models on laptops configured as main frequency and graphic display card to verify the rationality of the above algorithm, The time consumption of viewpoint selection of different models is tested, and the modeling efficiency of different input models is counted. The test results show that without program optimization, the viewpoint selection time of the model with the number of mesh patches of 15K ~ 50K ranges from 14 to 58s, among which the development of model visibility judgment and significance calculation is the largest, accounting for about 50% ~ 60% of the running time of the whole process. Therefore, the algorithm optimization of visibility judgment will help to improve the operation efficiency of the system and reduce the waiting time of users. Under the same input model, the computational efficiency of this algorithm is hundreds of times higher than that of the literature method. For the models in the table, due to the complex occlusion degree of patches, the modeling time of shallow relief is up to 3.778 seconds; For the mesh model with the number of patches below 35K, the efficiency of bas relief modeling is about, which basically meets the requirements of real-time.

articleTitle: Research on Table Tennis Training Plan Management System Based on SSM Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: There are many frameworks in the J2EE technology area, and the SSM framework has become the mainstream framework for Web development after SSH due to its superior performance and high development efficiency. This paper mainly accomplished three aspects. Firstly, we designed the system implementation process based on SSM framework, which consists of “Persistence layer, Business layer, Control layer and Presentation layer” for both Windows system and Android system. Secondly, based on the idea of modularity, we designed the system functions consisting of modules such as “Training plan formulation, Training plan analysis and Training situation diagnosis”, and used the hierarchical structure model to represent them. Thirdly, we analysed the three-layer functional framework of MyBatis and designed the persistence based on MyBatis. This paper is based on SSM layered architecture design, which improves the system development efficiency and reduces the system complexity.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Distributed Web Crawler Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: As the rapid growth of Internet, the related services and information are also growing rapidly. While this information is widely used by people, people have higher and higher requirements for information, and the web crawler, which is specially responsible for the collection of Internet information, is also facing great challenges. At present, large Internet companies at home and abroad and relevant research institutions have given some relatively mature solutions, but most of these solutions can only provide a search service for the general user that can not be customized and has been unable to meet the majority of users' benefit growth of various requirements. Considering the various needs of users, the distributed web crawler can meet the needs of users with its flexible information collection speed and scale. On the basis of analyzing the joints of the technical solutions of distributed web crawler, this paper designs a distributed web crawler structure based on knowledge map, and proposes a practical algorithm, which solves the key technologies of distributed web crawler and realizes a robust and distributed web crawler system. Finally, some tests are done on the web crawler, including the common crawler test and the web crawler test.

articleTitle: Research on the Maximum Coverage Algorithm of Airship Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Airship monitoring is a technology that uses airships to carry photoelectric equipment to continuously observe targets. Limited by equipment performance and aircraft altitude, the monitoring system has a limited observation area and cannot cover all target points in the area. In order to efficiently display the benefits of equipment and cover as many targets as possible, it is necessary to reasonably plan the location of the monitoring system. By modeling the problem of the maximum coverage of airship monitoring, the article uses the search algorithm based on mesh division, the search algorithm to determine the center of the circle, the search algorithm to determine the arc, and the most value solution algorithm of the function. Through simulation analysis, the results of the above algorithm are carried out to compare.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Processing Technology in Power Marketing System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Based on multi data fusion, this paper introduces a retrieval model for audio frequency data, which is combined with big data and applied to information retrieval. Firstly, the model is pre trained, and then the network parameters are fine-tuned through the network training method. By adjusting the network parameters, the recognition ability of the model is improved. In view of the assumption that whether external factors can interfere with external dependent variables on dependent variables, the multi group structure model is used for analysis. This method is a general method that can quickly find the target data under massive data. In the experiment, the features are used as the key words of the inverted table index to establish the table, and all the file information in the reference database will be stored in the corresponding entries in the inverted table according to its underlying features. When the feature of each query file finds data in the table, it only needs to use its eigenvalue to calculate the complexity once, and the information of the reference data with this feature can be searched.

articleTitle: Fast Adaptive Machine Vision Positioning Algorithm Based on Relative Threshold Features
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the vigorous development of machine vision, simultaneous positioning and methods based on vision have received extensive attention and research and are now commonly used positioning methods. In order to realize the problem of low efficiency and slow operation speed, a visual positioning algorithm is proposed. First, the algorithm uses relative thresholds for templates and sampled images, which effectively overcomes the impact and reduces the data. Secondly, the algorithm reduces the amount of calculation of the machine vision positioning algorithm, and adopts some methods to speed up and increase the speed, and can set some other conditions to further speed up. The algorithm can quickly locate the target in some ways, and then locate the center of the target faster, which could, to a large extent, accelerate machine vision and ensure the accuracy of the algorithm. The algorithm is fast and accurate, and can meet real-time requirements. Experimental research results show that pose estimation based on visual methods, compared with traditional pose estimation methods, uses relative threshold features as the main or only source of information, which can give a more detailed description of the environment in which the machine is located, and has good on-site performance characteristic.

articleTitle: Research on Ink Speed Recognition Method of Hyperspectral Imaging Ink Pad Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In this paper, the classification models in machine learning were combined with hyperspectral imaging technology to identify different brands or different models of stamp-pad inks of the same brand. Spectral acquisition of stamp-pad ink was performed under a hyperspectral imager, and the acquired spectral data was combined with machine learning classification algorithms to build an identification model and predict the class of the delineated prediction samples. The algorithms employed include linear discriminant analysis (LDA), parameter selection of support vector machines based on grid search (grid-SVM) and parameter selection of support vector machines based on particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO-SVM). After evaluating the identification models established by LDA, grid-SVM and PSO-SVM, the results show that PSO-SVM realizes the best classification results, with the accuracy for six different classes of stamp-pad inks of 96%, with further accuracy for a total of 10 various labels under each class of 95%, thereby achieving the discrimination of ink types that cannot be distinguished by conventional optical methods. Therefore, the model for the identification of stamp-pad ink types that are inaccessible by conventional optical methods was established. Ultimately, the identification of stamp-pad ink types can be realized by combing machine learning with hyperspectral imaging technology, providing a new, scientific and non-destructive examination method for seal examination, document addition and alteration, etc. It also provides an opportunity to build a new platform for the forensic science ink examination.

articleTitle: Data Processing in CPSS Platform Based on Data Mining and Cloud Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: CPSS, a better social-physical information system, can better achieve the management and control goals of security and efficiency of complex systems. The large amount of data information in this CPSS platform needs to be processed reasonably and quickly. The purpose of this article is to solve the problem of processing a large amount of data information in the CPSS platform. In combination with traditional statistical analysis technology and data mining technology(DMT), a detailed analysis and research on how to process the data in the CPSS platform is more detailed.., Theoretical analysis method, case analysis method, logical analysis method and other methods. By understanding the current status of domestic and foreign related research and DMT, it analyzes the main problems existing in the data processing and management of CPSS platform in China, and innovates DMT It is applied to the data processing of social physical information system, and the feasibility of data processing technology in CPSS platform is discussed systematically. The results show that the data processing method in CPSS platform based on data mining can enable CPSS platform to efficiently extract useful information when dealing with issues such as security of complex systems, thereby making the processing of massive data easier, more convenient, and more efficient.

articleTitle: An Information Fusion Technology for Statistical Analysis of Computer Professional Certificates
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In order to adapt to the information construction, improve work efficiency and reduce the work pressure of staff, this set of certificate statistical analysis system is developed. Using this system, we can easily count and analyze the acquisition of various certificates. When implementing various functions, in order to improve the degree of automation, we need to use a lot of spliced strings. Due to the non variability of string, the system performance is extremely low for the statistical technology of computer professional certificates information fusion. Multimodal information fusion involves many level, which have a great impact on the statistical technology. This paper uses information fusion and the statistical technology to finished computer digital authentication combining the optimization model. The construction data is described in detail. The experimental results show that the acquisition rate data of computer digital authentication can be improved. The results prove that view state can automatically maintain the state of server controls during page round-trip, reducing the workload of developers.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Sensing Images Clarification Algorithm Based on Grid Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of fast processing and image clarification of massive remote sensing images, I designed a grid computing-based remote sensing image clarification platform and developed the corresponding grid computing middleware. The image clarification process is carried out by using constrained power spectrum equalization filtering, and the effective chunking method is adopted to speed up the fast processing of massive data and solve the problems of boundary effects. The experimental results show that the grid platform can greatly improve the efficiency of processing massive amounts of data and obtain satisfactory clarification results.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Face Recognition Technology Based on Multi Feature Fusion from the Perspective of Aesthetics
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Face recognition is still one of the research hotspots in the field of pattern recognition and artificial intelligence. Compared with two-dimensional face images, three-dimensional face model can provide key depth information, which is less affected by pose and illumination, and has better adaptability to the change of expression. Through the research of 3D face recognition method, the difficulties of 2D face recognition are overcome. Aiming at the shortage of the existing 3D face data set, this paper designs a 3D face recognition method, and proposes a data set synthesized by 3dmm. At the same time, by transforming the expression and shape on the data set, enough face samples can be synthesized to obtain 3D face point cloud data with good expression ability, the accuracy of face recognition is improved by the 3D face recognition technology of multi feature fusion. For 3D face data, this paper uses face point cloud, which avoids the loss of key information when mapping from 3D face to 2D face, and avoids the huge data of 3D face voxel network.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Financial Accounting Reporting System Based on Computer Software
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's economy, the development of various companies is getting faster and faster. As an important part of China's leading industries, the company's most important plan is the construction of financial management information, and financial reports are centralized financial management information one of the core of this article, based on existing projects, mainly around the company's internal financial reporting needs, build a platform financial system, improve the performance and institutional requirements of centralized financial companies, and other existing social financial systems related to economic governance. Strengthen centralized financial management. Extend the financial management scope of the enterprise from the later stage of the business review to the front-end management of the business, so that the financial management principle of the enterprise becomes the reliance and the only standard of the business operation activities of the enterprise. Experiments show that the financial report management system of computer software has a small operating risk factor and good performance. The system is suitable for financial report management.

articleTitle: Image Recognition Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Image Recognition (IR) is one of the important research topics in the field of computer vision and pattern recognition, and it is also an important tool for the realization of an intelligent society in the future. Deep learning is a process of simulating the human visual system and the cognitive link of the human brain, extracting data features in a structured manner, and finally obtaining the deep information of the image. The whole training process can get a good IR effect without manual participation. The purpose of this article is to research IR algorithms based on deep learning. This paper firstly summarizes the algorithms of IR and deep learning. Aiming at the problems of deep learning objective cost function that is easy to fall into local minimum, slow convergence speed and over-fitting, it proposes the improvement of the algorithm on the deep learning model. At the same time, analyze and design the relevant parameters that affect the model to optimize the model. This paper proposes the weight threshold parameter variable analysis method, the original golden section method, the network structure determination method based on the sensitivity of network nodes, and the pyramid model structure method based on the convolutional network. The experimental results show that the algorithm based on the node sensitivity structure can recognize 1000 images in 3.14s, and the recognition accuracy rate is 98.6%, which is better than other methods.

articleTitle: The Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: In dealing with the problems of fuzzy reasoning and neural network(FNN) methods in pattern recognition, the paper proposes a fault reasoning method based on fuzzy neural network. The proposed FNN identifies the structure and parameters, and initializes and set the rules. The membership function in the process of fuzzification is optimized. Finally, the simulation results prove the proposed method can diagnose the reasons of the fault and the timeliness is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Text Classification in Architecture Field Based on Naive Bayes Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, it has become a problem to quickly and accurately find the information we need in the massive text information. And the method to solve the problem is text classification. This paper proposes a text classifier for the architectural field. The feature selection adopts the TF-IDF text classification method, which effectively reduces the computing time and creates conditions for improving the computing power of the text classifier. In the classification stage, Naive Bayes classifier, K nearest neighbour classifier and decision tree classifier are introduced for comparative analysis. Experiment shows that the prediction results of Naive Bayes are significantly improved compared with KNN and decision tree. Among the three groups of classifiers, the Naive Bayes classifier has the best performance. The classifier can effectively improve the recall rate and accuracy rate of the text classification in architectural field, and has a good use effect.

articleTitle: Improvement of Attribute Reduction Classification Algorithm Based on Rough Sets
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Since rough sets cannot deal with noisy image information, there will be inaccurate classification problems in image classification, and other algorithms must be combined to achieve accurate classification results. Although the neural network classification method can better extract image features, when the spatial dimension of the image is too large and the training time increases, it will also lead to low image classification accuracy. Therefore, this paper combines rough set(RS) theory and neural network(NN) classification for image processing, establishes a classification algorithm(CA) based on NN, and uses the attribute reduction(AR) of RS as the front end of neural network to solve the dimensionality problem when processing image information. Improves the accuracy of image classification(IC). The experimental results show that, compared with other CA, the rough set neural network CA in this paper can reduce the dimension of image attributes and achieve higher classification accuracy in image processing.

articleTitle: A Design of Turnout Health Monitoring Algorithm and System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: As an important part of railway operation safety, the quality of railway turnout and its conversion equipment will directly affect the railway operation safety. Therefore, the early warning and alarm of turnout condition, pre fault prevention and diagnosis are particularly important. At present, the railway has no effective turnout monitoring means, and the intellectualization of turnout monitoring still needs to be improved. The establishment of turnout monitoring system with intelligent monitoring means has become the focus of current research. In this paper, the turnout monitoring terminal is designed, combined with the field turnout sensor integration module and the field turnout monitoring and processing unit for joint experimental debugging. In order to realize asynchronous communication and ensure the reliability and flexibility of communication, the combination of remote procedure call and message middleware is used to realize the communication between the foreground monitoring terminal system and the background database. The test results show that the turnout monitoring terminal system has well completed the communication process with the on-site turnout sensor integration module and the on-site turnout monitoring and processing unit, basically completed the requirements for the turnout monitoring terminal system, and the test effect is good, which has a certain reference significance for the intelligent monitoring and research of turnout.

articleTitle: Solid-Fluid Interaction Simulation System Based on SPH Unified Particle Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 3D Immersion, Interaction and Multi-sensory Experiences (ICDIIME)
abstract: Solid-fluid Interaction Simulation is the important research point in the field of fluid simulation. Existing researches mainly focus on the phenomena such as motion, deformation, infiltration, erosion, etc., and less attention is paid to the solid fracture caused by fluid impact. The simulation solutions used by the related researches have weakly coupling with the SPH solid-fluid interaction framework because their solid fracture methods need the geometric form for representing and processing the solid model. For the same reason, their methods have difficulty to parallelize and achieve the balance between Realism and real-time performance. To deal with these problems, a full process parallelization simulation framework is proposed for parallelize each key stage of the simulation system. The framework is based on the SPH unified particle framework and has the advantage of high parallelism of the SPH method because of the particle form of solid used to describe and solve solid field quantities. For solving the solid fracture, a physics-geometry hybrid method with the high parallelism implementation is proposed. This method is also based on particle form to solve the solid field quantities so that have strong coupling with SPH framework. In term of neighborhood particle search, a spatial three-level index sorting based on the unified grid method is proposed to optimize neighborhood search processes including solid particles. Because the spatial characteristics of the solid fracture method is considered, the two methods can be closely combined with each other. In the stage of fluid rendering, in order to avoid the communication between GPU and CPU caused by surface extraction, the Screen Space Fluid Rendering method is adopted. In SSFR, the particle data is directly input into the rendering pipeline on GPU for rendering without transfer to CPU for extracting fluid mesh. For verifying the stability of the parallelized framework, performance and Realism of the simulation system, some scenes with different complexity are constructed for simulating. The results show that the framework can achieve well real-time performance in the scene with 650k particles and 180 solid chunks, and simulation is stable with the effects conformed to the phenomena of real-world physics.
